title: Priority catalog and proof bundler for enterprise compliance asks
creator: Aisha Kaur
description:
Problem: Sales and Support are fielding a high volume of enterprise security/compliance requests (SOC2, ISO, HIPAA, GDPR/DPA, vendor questionnaires). Triage is manual, inconsistent, and causes long response times and missed contractual commitments. We need a scalable PM-owned intake surface that classifies asks by risk and contractual exposure, routes to the right partner team, and auto-assembles a "proof bundle" (evidence artifacts + canned answers) for customers or RFP processes.

Goals: 1) Reduce mean time to first response (MTTR) for enterprise security asks from days to <24 hours for high-tier customers. 2) Standardize prioritization so the PM backlog and Security queue reflect business risk and contract exposure. 3) Automate generation of a pre-populated evidence bundle (S3/Drive links, audit report snippets, configuration screenshots, policy statements) for ~60% of inbound questionnaires. 4) Provide clear SLAs and escalation flows for Legal/Security/Infra.

Scope (MVP):
- Intake form redesign (Sales/Support facing) with discrete fields for product usage, data classes, regulatory regime, contract value, residency constraints, and requested artifact types.
- Risk-weighted scoring engine (rules-based) that assigns tier (Urgent / High / Standard / Low) using weighted signals: contract size, data sensitivity, regulatory type, customer geography, deal stage.
- Automated routing: High/Urgent -> Security + Solutions Engineering + Legal; Standard -> Solutions Engineering queue; Low -> self-serve evidence bundle.
- Evidence bundler: assemble PDFs/links from canonical evidence repo, apply templated answers, and produce a sanitized export for customer consumption.
- Backlog visibility: expose scoring and SLAs in Redwood Console for PM, Security, and Sales.

Implementation approach: 1) Work with Security to define canonical evidence map and allowed public-facing excerpts. 2) Build intake form and scoring microservice (rules engine first, ML later). 3) Integrate bundler with Drive/S3/KMS and create templates per regulation. 4) Add dashboard card in Console for intake metrics and queue state. 5) Pilot with top 10 enterprise customers and iterate.

Success metrics: MTTR for high-tier <=24h, % of asks auto-served by bundler >=60% for standard asks, mean SLA compliance >=95% for High/Urgent, reduction in manual Security/Lit hours by 30% in first quarter post-launch.
